full_text:
Akamaru is a Meso-Titan whose appearance is that of a snake-man, similar to that of Venomaster and Unnamed Titan 011.

History

Akamaru is an Incan snake spirit, known to throw himself completely into battle with no regard for his own safety. [SAS-076]

Abilities

Akamaru is armed with a sleek dagger to stab his enemies. He can use his Poison Cloud ability to sacrifice himself but disorientate his enemies allowing his side to get away. [SAS-076]
